title: Founded SF Express in the early 1990s to provide express delivery
statement: Founded SF Express in the early 1990s to provide express delivery between Guangdong manufacturers and Hong Kong buyers.
outcome: SF Express grew into SF Holding, a major Shenzhen-based multinational logistics conglomerate, with Wang remaining chairman and majority shareholder and an estimated net worth of $15.3 billion as of August 2026 per Wikipedia.
